# Our duty tool against the official WeBOC calculator (generated by `python -m src.eval.weboc_compare`)

49 tariff codes of FY2026-27, import value PKR 2829247 on 2026-10-16. WeBOC answers saved in `data\ground_truth\weboc_calculator_2026-10-16.json` (captured from the public calculator; not an owner check).
We compare customs duty, regulatory duty, additional customs duty, sales tax and federal excise duty amounts to the rupee (WeBOC truncates), and the income-tax RATE (ours for a commercial importer who is not a filer). WeBOC prints no 3% value-addition tax and no further tax, so those are not compared.

* Codes our tool could compute on these inputs: 33 of 49. The rest need more facts from the importer (listed below), so they are not compared.
* Of the 33 computed, **18 match WeBOC on every compared line**; 15 differ.
